stem: The frequency of dark fur has increased in a population of mice over time. Which environment MOST LIKELY led to this change?

options.label: A
options.text: An environment with a decreasing owl population over time

options.label: B
options.text: An environment with an increasing owl population over time

options.label: C
options.text: An environment that has less snowfall over time

options.label: D
options.text: An environment that has more snowfall over time
